# BMAD Sprint Board

A DSH Harness plugin that reads a
BMAD **v7** project and shows it
in the Session sidebar.

It answers two questions: **how healthy is the implementation**, and **what comes
next**. Not "are w

e on schedule" — the store holds no dates, and inventing them
would be the one thing this board refu

ule" — the store holds no dates, and inventing them
would be the one thing this board refuses to do.

**Read-only.** It never writes to your ticket store. Every action it offers is a
string you copy.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What you get
### Five views, one tab
| View | Shows |
| **Status** | The two numbers, the next step, one foldable lane per ticket state, and the findings

|
| **Requirements** | Every requirement the initiative declares: its state, and what claims to deli

ver it |
| **Epic** | One section per epic: its status, its tickets, and its progress |
| **Tickets*

* | Every ticket in the initiative, grouped by state, across all epics |
| **Initiatives** | Every i
nitiative with its status and counts, marking the active one |

Selecting an initiative in **Initiatives** loads it into the other four. The
selection is local: not

hing is written back, so looking at another initiative
cannot change which one BMAD considers active

ing is written back, so looking at another initiative
cannot change which one BMAD considers active.
### Two numbers, two meanings, never blended

| **Unfinished** | work committed and not delivered |
| **Does not add up** | two records disagreein

work committed and not delivered |
| **Does not add up** | two records disagreeing about one fact |

**Unfinished** sums the requirements nothing covers, deferred items still owed by
settled tickets, u

nticked review patches, UX runs the plan never names, UX
components no epic delivers, and epics with

ew patches, UX runs the plan never names, UX
components no epic delivers, and epics with no stories.

**Does not add up** sums containers that say `done` while their tickets are not,
leaf tickets no ind

ex lists, plans no entry claims, and status words the store
does not define.

Both count **items**, not findings: eleven unticked patches is eleven things to
do, and one finding

that says so is not eleven. Each number equals the length of
the lane beneath it, so you can count t
he entries and get the same answer.

Two facts are deliberately **not** in either number, because they are not debts:
files the store can

not classify, and initiatives with no epics. They appear once,
as a quiet line with a count, so noth
ing is hidden and nothing shouts.
### BMAD v7 only

This is version 2. Version 1 read BMAD v6 -- `sprint-status.yaml`, `epics.md`,
`spec-*.md` -- and no

ne of those exist in a v7 project. The two are different
data models, not different formatting, so t
he plugin is released in two versions:
| BMAD | Install |

| **v7** | `dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board` (this one, 2.x) |
| v6 | `dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board@1.0

7** | `dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board` (this one, 2.x) |
| v6 | `dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board@1.0.0` |

Opened on a v6 project, 2.x says so and points at 1.0.0 rather than rendering an
empty board.
### The checks
| | Fires when |

| **REQ** | a declared requirement has no epic and no ticket listing it in `covers` |
| **B1** | wor

k was deferred off a ticket the store now calls settled |
| **B3** | a settled ticket still has unti

cked `[Review][Patch]` items |
| **U1** | a UX design run exists and nothing in the plan names it |

| **U2** | a component pattern in `EXPERIENCE.md` is named by no epic or ticket |
| **E2** | an epic

exists and its ticket store lists no stories |
| **C1** | an epic says `done` while tickets inside

it are not |
| **C2** | an initiative says `done` while tickets inside it are not |
| **L2** | a lea

f ticket exists on disk with no entry in the ticket index |
| **L3** | a plan file corresponds to no

index entry |
| **L4** | a ticket carries a status word the store does not define |
| **L1** | a fi

le in a ticket folder is neither a leaf ticket nor a plan, so the store ignores it |
| **E1** | an i
nitiative's ticket store lists no epics |

**L1 is worth knowing about on a migrated project.** The store decides what a
file is from its front

matter `type`: `story`, `spike` or `bug` is a leaf that
carries the ticket, anything else declaring

a `ticket` key is a plan over one,
and anything else is ignored. A file named `story-x-plan.md` whos

e type is
`feature` and which names no ticket is therefore *neither* — invisible to the
tooling, whi

ch reports its ticket as backlog however finished the work is. Every
number it prints is wrong while
every file on disk looks correct.

**The board's lanes are the store's lanes.** States come from `tickets.py`'s own
table rather than b

eing invented: an empty status is **backlog**, because a
planned story looks exactly like that befor

e `bmad-build` writes its plan — a
plan is an artefact of building, not a precondition of existing.

Only a status
word the store does not define becomes *unknown*, and it is counted as a
contradiction
rather than as settled.

**A declared container status is believed as written.** An initiative finished and
later stripped of

its tickets is indistinguishable from one that never started, so
[该节后续省略]
### On the ticket card

Everything the store already records, on one line, so the card stays a card:
`assignee`, `risk`, `es

timate`, `after` (dependencies), and `blocked_reason` —
which replaces the rest when present, becaus

e "blocked and nobody says why" is
the state the line exists to prevent.

`hitl` appears **only while the ticket is unsettled**. A finished ticket whose
human step was perfor

med still carries the flag, and nagging about work already
done is how a board stops being believed.
